Recovery of a partially directed structure

Source: R/metrics.R
mc_cpdag_metrics.Rd

Compares an estimated completed partially directed acyclic graph (CPDAG) with a known one, separating what the skeleton recovers from what the orientation does.

Usage

mc_cpdag_metrics(estimated, truth)

Arguments

estimated, truth

square adjacency matrices of the same dimension with zeros and ones and a zero diagonal, in the package convention: entries \((i,j)\) and \((j,i)\) both set mean an undirected edge, and only \((i,j)\) set means the arc \(i \to j\).

Value

A named numeric vector with cpdag_shd, cpdag_skeleton_f1, cpdag_skeleton_shd, cpdag_vstructure_recall, cpdag_vstructure_precision, cpdag_orient_recall and cpdag_overorient.

What each measure counts

Every pair of responses is in one of four states: absent, undirected, or directed either way. cpdag_shd counts the pairs whose states differ. The skeleton measures (cpdag_skeleton_f1, cpdag_skeleton_shd) are those of mc_structure_metrics and ignore direction. cpdag_orient_recall is the proportion of the pairs the truth directs that the estimate carries in the same state, and cpdag_overorient the proportion of the pairs the truth leaves undirected while joining them that the estimate directs, which is the rate at which a direction is invented. A v-structure is a triple \(i \to k \leftarrow j\) with \(i\) and \(j\) nonadjacent. V-structure recall is the proportion of the true v-structures that the estimate declares, and precision the proportion of the declared ones that are true; recall is conditional on the truth containing one and precision on some v-structure having been declared, and either is NA when its condition is empty.

See also

mc_true_cpdag to build the true CPDAG of a DAG, mc_structure_metrics.

Other structure recovery: mc_structure_metrics(), mc_true_cpdag()

Examples

truth <- matrix(0L, 3, 3)
truth[1, 3] <- truth[2, 3] <- 1L          # 1 -> 3 <- 2
est <- truth
mc_cpdag_metrics(est, truth)
#>                  cpdag_shd          cpdag_skeleton_f1 
#>                          0                          1 
#>         cpdag_skeleton_shd    cpdag_vstructure_recall 
#>                          0                          1 
#> cpdag_vstructure_precision        cpdag_orient_recall 
#>                          1                          1 
#>           cpdag_overorient 
#>                         NA
